title: Free public transport for the 2026 elections in Campo Grande and Sorocaba
seoTitle: Free Transit in Campo Grande and Sorocaba: 2026
subtitle: Cities in the Central-West and Southeast guarantee free mobility on election day
excerpt: On October 4, 2026, Campo Grande and Sorocaba will offer free buses for voters, following a TSE resolution requiring transit compatible with demand.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
On the morning of the first round of the 2026 elections, voters in Campo Grande (MS) and Sorocaba (SP) will find free buses on the streets, a measure provided for in Resolution No. 23,751 of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE). The initiative aims to ensure that the population can reach voting locations at no additional cost.

Free transport in Campo Grande on election Sunday

AGETRAN reported that all bus routes in the capital of Mato Grosso do Sul will operate on a weekday schedule, with no fare charged, to guarantee voter transit. The Guaicurus Consortium will monitor demand and may expand the fleet, especially during the periods of 4:40 a.m.–8:30 a.m., 10:30 a.m.–1:30 p.m., and 4 p.m.–7 p.m.

Special traffic and transit operation in Sorocaba

In Sorocaba, the Secretariat of Mobility and Urbes are coordinating a special operation that includes entirely free public transit on election Sunday. The service will follow the weekday schedule, with 136 routes, 363 vehicles, and around 9,269 trips, serving approximately 824,000 passengers.

Rules for using the free service

In both cities, the free fare will be automatic: bus turnstiles will be unlocked to rotate without the need for a card or proof of eligibility. Access will also be guaranteed for people with disabilities or reduced mobility, as provided for in the resolution.

Impact on roads and recommendations

In addition to transit, city halls will reinforce the presence of traffic agents and video monitoring. In Sorocaba, areas near electoral offices will have scheduled closures, requiring drivers and voters to plan their routes in advance and respect temporary signage.

Objective of the measure

The actions of Campo Grande and Sorocaba comply with the TSE ruling to provide urban public transport in a capacity compatible with weekday operations, facilitating the population's movement and contributing to the safety and flow of traffic on election day.

With information from G1, Sorocaba City Hall.
